description.en:
Returns a player parameter ID, as its CRC32 hash, stored in the match setup data (a block filled by the match menus).
The only script that uses it is the system event ev43030000, which passes it to CreateEvLowMdlForMatch to show the model of a "nakama" (new teammate) next to the protagonist. That fits the player who joins the team after a challenge. The part of the engine that fills this value was not traced.

The stored CRC32 of a player parameter ID.
null if the match system is not ready.

examples.case: Showing the new teammate's model (real usage, from ev43030000.nut; the model name is romanised from the script's Shift-JIS string)
